displayTitle: The High Republic Adventures Free Comic Book Day 2021
synopsis: The High Republic Adventures Free Comic Book Day 2021 is a one-shot issue that will serve as a prelude to the canon comic book series Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures. The issue is written by Daniel José Older and published as a Free Comic Book Day title by IDW Publishing.Join Yoda, Buckets o'Blood, and their Padawan learners as they go on an adventure to help maintain peace during the glory days of the Republic, in a prelude to IDW's Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures series! Written by series architect Daniel José Older, this is the ideal entry into the world of the High Republic-and a can't-miss story for fans!
title: The High Republic Adventures Free Comic Book Day 2021
